# Design Philosophy

Laserheart is a science fiction framework built on the Daggerheart SRD. Its purpose is to let a table drop into any sci-fi setting — space opera, military sci-fi, cyberpunk, hard science — without relearning the game. If you know Daggerheart, you can play Laserheart in minutes.

Three principles guide every design decision:

::: {.callout-note title="Principle 01 — Setting Agnostic"}
No proper nouns. No licensed worlds. Laserheart describes archetypes, not franchises. A "Ranged Sidearm" works in every sci-fi universe; a "DL-44 Heavy Blaster Pistol" only works in one. Players bring their own fiction; Laserheart provides the mechanical scaffolding.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Principle 02 — Close to Home"}
Wherever possible, Laserheart uses the same mechanical structure as Daggerheart. The Hope/Fear economy, Stress, Evasion, Action Rolls, and the card-based ability system are all preserved. The goal is a new coat of paint, not a new engine.
:::

::: {.callout-warning title="Principle 03 — Modular by Design"}
"Enhanced Play" — covering psionics, alien powers, and exotic technology — is an optional module. A table running hard military sci-fi can ignore it entirely. A table running space fantasy can enable it fully. The base system works without it.
:::
